case_metadata.drug_detail: 0.25 mg subcutaneous once weekly, titrated per prescribing information
case_metadata.design_note: The disputed fact is trivially present and the note is dense with unrelated clinical material — eight active problems, eight medications, a full rheumatology assessment and a post-operative review. The denial is a documentation-not-found denial rather than a criterion-not-met denial, which is the most common real-world variety and the easiest for a retrieval-weak pipeline to affirm wrongly.

denial_ground_truth.denial_reason_text: The submitted records do not provide the documentation required to establish a baseline body mass index of 35 kg/m2 or greater.
denial_ground_truth.cited_policy_reference: Aetna Pharmacy Clinical Policy Bulletin, "Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP-GLP-1 GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit 6450-C UDR 05-2024," COVERAGE CRITERIA — Chronic Weight Management (Adult)
denial_ground_truth.cited_requirement_text: The patient has a baseline body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 35 kg/m2 [ACTION REQUIRED: Documentation is required for approval.]
records_reviewed_at_denial: Prior authorization request form received 2026-03-03, with height and weight fields blank

policy_ground_truth.policy_name: Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP-GLP-1 GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit 6450-C UDR 05-2024

criteria.requirement: Baseline BMI greater than or equal to 35 kg/m2, with documentation.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient has a baseline body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 35 kg/m2 [ACTION REQUIRED: Documentation is required for approval.]

criteria.requirement: Participation in a comprehensive weight management program with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient has participated in a comprehensive weight management program that encourages behavioral modification, reduced calorie diet, and increased physical activity with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy

criteria.requirement: Patient is 18 years of age or older.
criteria.policy_support_text: The patient is 18 years of age or older

criteria.requirement: The requested drug will be used with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management.
criteria.policy_support_text: used with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management

scope_notes: The documentation requirement attaches to the BMI criterion. It is satisfied by a chart entry recording height, weight and BMI; the policy does not specify a form or format.

evidence_ground_truth.evidence_timing_note: The 2026-02-24 note was submitted with the PA. The BMI was in the submitted material; the reviewer did not locate it in a dense multi-problem note.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: OBJECTIVE section records height 5 ft 2 in, weight 225 lb, BMI 41.1 kg/m2, with a weight series of 232 lb (BMI 42.4) on 08/11/2025, 228 lb (BMI 41.7) on 11/24/2025 and 225 lb (BMI 41.1) on 02/24/2026. Assessment item 2 repeats the BMI and the Z68.41 code for BMI 40.0 to 44.9.
Seven dated Corvale programme contacts from 08/11/2025 through 02/16/2026, a span of 189 days, covering calorie target and food diary, behavioural groups and an adapted activity prescription.
DOB 12/03/1975; age 50 at the time of the request.
Plan item 2 states she will continue the Corvale eating plan and the pool and seated exercise sessions alongside the medication.

missing_evidence.description: The prior authorization form itself was submitted with height and weight blank. That is a form-completion failure, not an absence of documentation in the record.

per_criterion.reason: BMI 41.1 kg/m2 documented with height and weight in the submitted note, well above the 35 kg/m2 threshold, and corroborated by two earlier recorded values and by the assessment's diagnosis coding.
Seven dated contacts spanning 189 days with continuing follow-up, covering diet, behaviour and physical activity, all before any drug therapy.
The plan continues the eating plan and adapted exercise programme alongside the drug.

supported_claims: The submitted note documents height, weight and BMI in its objective section, satisfying the documentation requirement attached to the BMI criterion.
The documented BMI of 41.1 kg/m2 exceeds the 35 kg/m2 threshold by a wide margin, and every recorded value in the episode is above 41.
The six-month program criterion is satisfied and is not disputed.
The blank fields on the authorization form do not reflect an absence of documentation in the clinical record.
unsupported_claims: That the member's rheumatoid arthritis, hypothyroidism or osteopenia bears on eligibility under this pathway.
That the member meets the continuation-of-therapy criteria.
That the member trialled another weight-loss agent.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: Documented BMI on February 24, 2026 was 41.1 kg/m2, with height 5 feet 2 inches and weight 225 pounds.
Recorded BMI values in the episode are 42.4, 41.7 and 41.1 kg/m2.
The assessment records obesity with the Z68.41 code for a BMI of 40.0 to 44.9.
Seven dated Corvale programme contacts are documented from August 11, 2025 through February 16, 2026.
The programme was adapted for joint limitation, with pool sessions added in November 2025 and a seated strength circuit in January 2026.
The member was 50 years of age at the time of the request.
The member has used no prescription weight-loss medication and has no GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member's rheumatoid arthritis or its treatment creates an alternative coverage route under this policy.
This policy permits coverage at a BMI of 30 kg/m2, or at 27 kg/m2 with a weight-related comorbidity.
The member failed a trial of phentermine, Qsymia, Contrave, or orlistat.
The member's prior cholecystectomy is a contraindication that entitles her to an exception.
The member completed twelve months of a weight management program.
